description: This file defines a jQuery plugin extension called 'popoverext' that extends Bootstrap's tooltip/popover functionality with additional features such as custom positioning, footer content, id setting, and show behavior. It provides a constructor, prototype methods, and jQuery plugin registration.

classes.name: PopoverExt
classes.description: A constructor function for the extended popover, extending Bootstrap's tooltip/popover.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the popover extension with event bindings and options.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the popover, including title, content, and footer.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks whether the popover has any content to display.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Assigns a custom ID to the popover element if specified in options.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the popover with positioning, animation, and event handling.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Retrieves footer content from data attribute or options.
